                     \\\n            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);                                               \\\n        }                                                                     \\\n    } while (0)\n\nstatic const int WARP_SIZE = 32;\nstatic const int BLOCK_THREADS = 256;                          // 8 warps / block\nstatic const int WARPS_PER_BLOCK = BLOCK_THREADS / WARP_SIZE;\nstatic const unsigned FULL_MASK = 0xffffffffu;\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Device code\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ double devDistance(const Point a, const Point b) {\n    const double dx = a.x - b.x;\n    const double dy = a.y - b.y;\n    return sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// CSR-style adjacency listing, for every point, all other points that are\n// strictly closer than the threshold.  Only those can ever share a cluster\n// with it, so a candidate cluster never has to look at anything else.\n// `offsets == nullptr` means the lists were too large to precompute.\nstruct NeighborList {\n    const int* offsets;    // N + 1 entries\n    const int* idx;        // neighbour point ids\n    const double* dist;    // matching distances (all < threshold)\n};\n\n// Precompute the full (symmetric) pairwise distance matrix.\n__global__ void buildDistanceMatrix(const Point* __restrict__ points, int N,\n                                    double* __restrict__ dmat) {\n    const int j = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    const int i = blockIdx.y;\n    if (j >= N) return;\n    dmat[static_cast<size_t>(i) * N + j] = devDistance(points[i], points[j]);\n}\n\ntemplate <bool USE_MATRIX>\n__device__ __forceinline__ double lookupDistance(int a, int b,\n                                                 const Point* __restrict__ points,\n                                                 const double* __restrict__ dmat,\n                                                 int N) {\n    if (USE_MATRIX) {\n        return __ldg(&dmat[static_cast<size_t>(a) * N + b]);\n    }\n    return devDistance(points[a], points[b]);\n}\n\n// Pass 1 of the neighbour-list construction: how many points are in range.\ntemplate <bool USE_MATRIX>\n__global__ void countNeighbors(int N, double threshold,\n                               const Point* __restrict__ points,\n                               const double* __restrict__ dmat,\n                               int* __restrict__ counts) {\n    const int i = blockIdx.x;\n    int local = 0;\n    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < N; j += blockDim.x) {\n        if (j == i) continue;\n        if (lookupDistance<USE_MATRIX>(i, j, points, dmat, N) < threshold) ++local;\n    }\n    __shared__ int sTotal;\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) sTotal = 0;\n    __syncthreads();\n    atomicAdd(&sTotal, local);\n    __syncthreads();\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) counts[i] = sTotal;\n}\n\n// Pass 2: fill in the neighbour ids together with their distances.\ntemplate <bool USE_MATRIX>\n__global__ void fillNeighbors(int N, double threshold,\n                              const Point* __restrict__ points,\n                              const double* __restrict__ dmat,\n                              const int* __restrict__ offsets,\n                              int* __restrict__ nbrIdx, double* __restrict__ nbrDist) {\n    const int i = blockIdx.x;\n    const int lane = threadIdx.x & (WARP_SIZE - 1);\n    const unsigned lanesBelow = (1u << lane) - 1u;\n    const int base = offsets[i];\n\n    __shared__ int sCursor;\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) sCursor = 0;\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    const int lim = (N + blockDim.x - 1) / blockDim.x * blockDim.x;\n    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < lim; j += blockDim.x) {\n        double d = 0.0;\n        bool keep = false;\n        if (j < N && j != i) {\n            d = lookupDistance<USE_MATRIX>(i, j, points, dmat, N);\n            keep = d < threshold;\n        }\n        const unsigned mask = __ballot_sync(FULL_MASK, keep);\n        int warpBase = 0;\n        if (lane == 0) warpBase = atomicAdd(&sCursor, __popc(mask));\n        warpBase = __shfl_sync(FULL_MASK, warpBase, 0);\n        if (keep) {\n            const int pos = base + warpBase + __popc(mask & lanesBelow);\n            nbrIdx[pos] = j;\n            nbrDist[pos] = d;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Warp-wide reduction picking the smallest diameter; ties go to the smaller\n// point index (matching the sequential `max_dist < min_diameter` scan order).\n__device__ __forceinline__ void warpArgMin(double& bestDiam, int& bestIdx) {\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int off = WARP_SIZE / 2; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n        const double od = __shfl_down_sync(FULL_MASK, bestDiam, off);\n        const int oi = __shfl_down_sync(FULL_MASK, bestIdx, off);\n        if (od < bestDiam || (od == bestDiam && oi < bestIdx)) {\n            bestDiam = od;\n            bestIdx = oi;\n        }\n    }\n    bestDiam = __shfl_sync(FULL_MASK, bestDiam, 0);\n    bestIdx = __shfl_sync(FULL_MASK, bestIdx, 0);\n}\n\n// Grow the candidate cluster of one seed with a single warp.\n// Returns the cardinality; when `members` is non-null the member list is\n// written to it (in the order in which the sequential code appends them).\ntemplate <bool USE_MATRIX>\n__device__ int growCluster(int seed, int N, double threshold,\n                           const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                           const Point* __restrict__ points,\n                           const double* __restrict__ dmat,\n                           const NeighborList nbr,\n                           int* __restrict__ actA, double* __restrict__ diamA,\n                           int* __restrict__ actB, double* __restrict__ diamB,\n                           int* __restrict__ members) {\n    const int lane = threadIdx.x & (WARP_SIZE - 1);\n    const unsigned lanesBelow = (1u << lane) - 1u;\n\n    int* act = actA;\n    double* diam = diamA;\n    int* actNext = actB;\n    double* diamNext = diamB;\n\n    // Seed the candidate list: every unclustered point that is close enough to\n    // the seed itself.  Everything else can never join this cluster.\n    int count = 0;\n    if (nbr.offsets != nullptr) {\n        // Walk only the precomputed in-range neighbours of the seed.\n        const int begin = nbr.offsets[seed];\n        const int end = nbr.offsets[seed + 1];\n        const int lim = begin + (((end - begin) + WARP_SIZE - 1) & ~(WARP_SIZE - 1));\n        for (int k = begin + lane; k < lim; k += WARP_SIZE) {\n            int c = -1;\n            double d = 0.0;\n            bool keep = false;\n            if (k < end) {\n                c = nbr.idx[k];\n                d = nbr.dist[k];\n                keep = !clustered[c];\n            }\n            const unsigned mask = __ballot_sync(FULL_MASK, keep);\n            if (keep) {\n                const int pos = count + __popc(mask & lanesBelow);\n                act[pos] = c;\n                diam[pos] = d;\n            }\n            count += __popc(mask);\n        }\n    } else {\n        const int limN = (N + WARP_SIZE - 1) & ~(WARP_SIZE - 1);\n        for (int c = lane; c < limN; c += WARP_SIZE) {\n            double d = 0.0;\n            bool keep = (c < N) && (c != seed) && !clustered[c];\n            if (keep) {\n                d = lookupDistance<USE_MATRIX>(c, seed, points, dmat, N);\n                keep = d < threshold;\n            }\n            const unsigned mask = __ballot_sync(FULL_MASK, keep);\n            if (keep) {\n                const int pos = count + __popc(mask & lanesBelow);\n                act[pos] = c;\n                diam[pos] = d;\n            }\n            count += __popc(mask);\n        }\n    }\n\n    int cardinality = 1;\n    if (members != nullptr && lane == 0) members[0] = seed;\n\n    while (count > 0) {\n        // Closest admissible candidate.\n        double bestDiam = INFINITY;\n        int bestIdx = -1;\n        const int limC = (count + WARP_SIZE - 1) & ~(WARP_SIZE - 1);\n        for (int i = lane; i < limC; i += WARP_SIZE) {\n            if (i < count) {\n                const double d = diam[i];\n                const int idx = act[i];\n                if (d < bestDiam || (d == bestDiam && idx < bestIdx)) {\n                    bestDiam = d;\n                    bestIdx = idx;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        warpArgMin(bestDiam, bestIdx);\n\n        if (members != nullptr && lane == 0) members[cardinality] = bestIdx;\n        ++cardinality;\n\n        // Update the running diameters and drop candidates that became\n        // inadmissible (their diameter can only grow from here on).\n        int nextCount = 0;\n        for (int i = lane; i < limC; i += WARP_SIZE) {\n            double nd = 0.0;\n            int c = -1;\n            bool keep = false;\n            if (i < count) {\n                c = act[i];\n                keep = (c != bestIdx);\n                if (keep) {\n                    const double d = lookupDistance<USE_MATRIX>(c, bestIdx, points, dmat, N);\n                    nd = fmax(diam[i], d);\n                    keep = nd < threshold;\n                }\n            }\n            const unsigned mask = __ballot_sync(FULL_MASK, keep);\n            if (keep) {\n                const int pos = nextCount + __popc(mask & lanesBelow);\n                actNext[pos] = c;\n                diamNext[pos] = nd;\n            }\n            nextCount += __popc(mask);\n        }\n\n        int* ti = act;   act = actNext;       actNext = ti;\n        double* td = diam; diam = diamNext;   diamNext = td;\n        count = nextCount;\n    }\n\n    return cardinality;\n}\n\n// One warp per seed, grid-stride over the seed list.\ntemplate <bool USE_MATRIX>\n__global__ void candidateCardinalityKernel(int nSeeds, const int* __restrict__ seeds,\n                                           int N, double threshold,\n                                           const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                           const Point* __restrict__ points,\n                                           const double* __restrict__ dmat,\n                                           const NeighborList nbr,\n                                           int* __restrict__ actA, double* __restrict__ diamA,\n                                           int* __restrict__ actB, double* __restrict__ diamB,\n                                           int* __restrict__ memberScratch,\n                                           int* __restrict__ cardinality) {\n    const int lane = threadIdx.x & (WARP_SIZE - 1);\n    const int warpId = blockIdx.x * WARPS_PER_BLOCK + (threadIdx.x >> 5);\n    const int totalWarps = gridDim.x * WARPS_PER_BLOCK;\n    const size_t base = static_cast<size_t>(warpId) * N;\n\n    for (int s = warpId; s < nSeeds; s += totalWarps) {\n        // When one warp is available per seed (the common case) the member\n        // list is recorded right away, so the winner never has to be regrown.\n        int* members = (memberScratch != nullptr)\n                           ? memberScratch + static_cast<size_t>(s) * N\n                           : nullptr;\n        const int card = growCluster<USE_MATRIX>(seeds[s], N, threshold, clustered,\n                                                 points, dmat, nbr, actA + base,\n                                                 diamA + base, actB + base,\n                                                 diamB + base, members);\n        if (lane == 0) cardinality[s] = card;\n    }\n}\n\n// Largest cardinality wins; ties go to the earliest seed (the sequential code\n// only replaces the best on a strict `>`), single block.  When the member\n// lists were recorded, the winning one is also emitted here.\n__global__ void selectBestSeedKernel(int nSeeds, const int* __restrict__ cardinality,\n                                     const int* __restrict__ memberScratch, int N,\n                                     int* __restrict__ out,\n                                     int* __restrict__ bestPos) {\n    __shared__ int sCard[BLOCK_THREADS];\n    __shared__ int sPos[BLOCK_THREADS];\n\n    int bc = -1;\n    int bp = nSeeds;\n    for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < nSeeds; i += blockDim.x) {\n        const int c = cardinality[i];\n        if (c > bc) { bc = c; bp = i; }\n    }\n    sCard[threadIdx.x] = bc;\n    sPos[threadIdx.x] = bp;\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    for (int stride = blockDim.x >> 1; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {\n        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {\n            const int oc = sCard[threadIdx.x + stride];\n            const int op = sPos[threadIdx.x + stride];\n            if (oc > sCard[threadIdx.x] ||\n                (oc == sCard[threadIdx.x] && op < sPos[threadIdx.x])) {\n                sCard[threadIdx.x] = oc;\n                sPos[threadIdx.x] = op;\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    const int pos = sPos[0];\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) bestPos[0] = pos;\n\n    if (memberScratch != nullptr) {\n        const int card = cardinality[pos];\n        if (threadIdx.x == 0) out[0] = card;\n        const int* src = memberScratch + static_cast<size_t>(pos) * N;\n        for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < card; i += blockDim.x) out[1 + i] = src[i];\n    }\n}\n\n// Regenerate the winning cluster and record its members.\n// out[0] = cardinality, out[1 .. cardinality] = members.\ntemplate <bool USE_MATRIX>\n__global__ void recordBestClusterKernel(const int* __restrict__ seeds,\n                                        const int* __restrict__ bestPos,\n                                        int N, double threshold,\n                                        const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                        const Point* __restrict__ points,\n                                        const double* __restrict__ dmat,\n                                        const NeighborList nbr,\n                                        int* __restrict__ actA, double* __restrict__ diamA,\n                                        int* __restrict__ actB, double* __restrict__ diamB,\n                                        int* __restrict__ out) {\n    const int lane = threadIdx.x & (WARP_SIZE - 1);\n    const int seed = seeds[bestPos[0]];\n    const int card = growCluster<USE_MATRIX>(seed, N, threshold, clustered, points, dmat,\n                                             nbr, actA, diamA, actB, diamB, out + 1);\n    if (lane == 0) out[0] = card;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Host driver\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nnamespace {\n\nstruct DeviceState {\n    Point* points = nullptr;\n    double* dmat = nullptr;          // optional precomputed distance matrix\n    unsigned char* clustered = nullptr;\n    int* seeds = nullptr;\n    int* cardinality = nullptr;\n    int* bestPos = nullptr;\n    int* out = nullptr;\n    int* actA = nullptr;\n    int* actB = nullptr;\n    double* diamA = nullptr;\n    double* diamB = nullptr;\n    int* memberScratch = nullptr;\n    int warps = 0;\n    int blocks = 0;\n    bool useMatrix = false;\n};\n\n// Pick the number of concurrently resident warps: one per seed if the\n// per-warp scratch space fits, otherwise as many as memory allows.\nint chooseWarpCount(int N, size_t freeBytes, size_t matrixBytes) {\n    const size_t perWarp = static_cast<size_t>(N) * (3 * sizeof(int) + 2 * sizeof(double));\n    size_t budget = 0;\n    if (freeBytes > matrixBytes) {\n        budget = freeBytes - matrixBytes;\n        // Leave head room for the small bookkeeping arrays and the allocator.\n        budget = (budget > (256u << 20)) ? budget - (256u << 20) : budget / 2;\n    }\n    size_t maxWarps = budget / perWarp;\n    if (maxWarps < static_cast<size_t>(WARPS_PER_BLOCK)) maxWarps = WARPS_PER_BLOCK;\n    int warps = static_cast<int>(std::min<size_t>(maxWarps, static_cast<size_t>(N)));\n    // Round up to whole blocks.\n    warps = ((warps + WARPS_PER_BLOCK - 1) / WARPS_PER_BLOCK) * WARPS_PER_BLOCK;\n    return warps;\n}\n\n}  // namespace\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    if (N == 0) return clusters;\n\n    std::vector<unsigned char> clustered(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices(N);\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) unclustered_indices[i] = i;\n\n    size_t freeBytes = 0, totalBytes = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&freeBytes, &totalBytes));\n\n    DeviceState dev;\n    const size_t matrixBytes = static_cast<size_t>(N) * static_cast<size_t>(N) * sizeof(double);\n    // Use the precomputed matrix whenever it comfortably fits; FP64 sqrt is\n    // expensive on the GPU, so this is a large win when it is affordable.\n    dev.useMatrix = (matrixBytes + matrixBytes / 4 + (256u << 20) < freeBytes);\n\n    dev.warps = chooseWarpCount(N, freeBytes, dev.useMatrix ? matrixBytes : 0);\n    dev.blocks = dev.warps / WARPS_PER_BLOCK;\n    const size_t scratch = static_cast<size_t>(dev.warps) * N;\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dev.points, N * sizeof(Point)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dev.clustered, N * sizeof(unsigned char)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dev.seeds, N * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dev.cardinality, N * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dev.bestPos, sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dev.out, (N + 1) * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dev.actA, scratch * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dev.actB, scratch * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dev.diamA, scratch * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dev.diamB, scratch * sizeof(double)));\n    if (dev.warps >= N) {\n        // Every seed gets its own warp, so its member list can be kept.\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dev.memberScratch, scratch * sizeof(int)));\n    }\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dev.points, points.data(), N * sizeof(Point),\n                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(dev.clustered, 0, N * sizeof(unsigned char)));\n\n    if (dev.useMatrix) {\n        if (cudaMalloc(&dev.dmat, matrixBytes) != cudaSuccess) {\n            dev.dmat = nullptr;\n            dev.useMatrix = false;\n        } else {\n            const int tpb = 256;\n            const dim3 grid((N + tpb - 1) / tpb, N);\n            buildDistanceMatrix<<<grid, tpb>>>(dev.points, N, dev.dmat);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Pinned staging buffers keep the per-round transfers cheap.\n    int* hSeeds = nullptr;\n    int* hOut = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&hSeeds, N * sizeof(int), cudaHostAllocDefault));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&hOut, (N + 1) * sizeof(int), cudaHostAllocDefault));\n\n    // Main clustering loop: one round per cluster.\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        const int nSeeds = static_cast<int>(unclustered_indices.size());\n        std::copy(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(), hSeeds);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dev.seeds, hSeeds, nSeeds * sizeof(int),\n                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n        const int blocks = std::min(dev.blocks,\n                                    (nSeeds + WARPS_PER_BLOCK - 1) / WARPS_PER_BLOCK);\n        if (dev.useMatrix) {\n            candidateCardinalityKernel<true><<<blocks, BLOCK_THREADS>>>(\n                nSeeds, dev.seeds, N, threshold, dev.clustered, dev.points, dev.dmat,\n                nbr, dev.actA, dev.diamA, dev.actB, dev.diamB, dev.memberScratch,\n                dev.cardinality);\n        } else {\n            candidateCardinalityKernel<false><<<blocks, BLOCK_THREADS>>>(\n                nSeeds, dev.seeds, N, threshold, dev.clustered, dev.points, dev.dmat,\n                nbr, dev.actA, dev.diamA, dev.actB, dev.diamB, dev.memberScratch,\n                dev.cardinality);\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n        selectBestSeedKernel<<<1, BLOCK_THREADS>>>(nSeeds, dev.cardinality,\n                                                   dev.memberScratch, N, dev.out,\n                                                   dev.bestPos);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n        if (dev.memberScratch == nullptr) {\n            // Not enough memory to keep every member list: regrow the winner.\n            if (dev.useMatrix) {\n                recordBestClusterKernel<true><<<1, WARP_SIZE>>>(\n                    dev.seeds, dev.bestPos, N, threshold, dev.clustered, dev.points,\n                    dev.dmat, nbr, dev.actA, dev.diamA, dev.actB, dev.diamB, dev.out);\n            } else {\n                recordBestClusterKernel<false><<<1, WARP_SIZE>>>(\n                    dev.seeds, dev.bestPos, N, threshold, dev.clustered, dev.points,\n                    dev.dmat, nbr, dev.actA, dev.diamA, dev.actB, dev.diamB, dev.out);\n            }\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        }\n\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hOut, dev.out, (N + 1) * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n\n        const int cardinality = hOut[0];\n        Cluster cluster;\n        cluster.seed_point = hOut[1];\n        cluster.members.assign(hOut + 1, hOut + 1 + cardinality);\n        clusters.push_back(cluster);\n\n        for (int i = 0; i < cardinality; ++i) clustered[cluster.members[i]] = 1;\n        unclustered_indices.erase(\n            std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                           [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx] != 0; }),\n            unclustered_indices.end());\n\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dev.clustered, clustered.data(),\n                                   N * sizeof(unsigned char), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    }\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hSeeds));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hOut));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dev.points));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dev.clustered));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dev.seeds));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dev.cardinality));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dev.bestPos));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dev.out));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dev.actA));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dev.actB));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dev.diamA));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dev.diamB));\n    if (dev.memberScratch) CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dev.memberScratch));\n    if (dev.dmat) CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dev.dmat));\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n\n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n\n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n\n        // Check diameter (max distance between any two points)\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]],\n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\",\n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n\n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\",\n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %zu)\\n\",\n                       member, membership[member], c);\n                valid = false;\n            }\n            membership[member] = static_cast<int>(c);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Count clustered points\n    int clustered_count = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < membership.size(); ++i) {\n        if (Quality Threshold) clustering is an algorithm that builds clusters\n// by starting with a seed point and iteratively adding the closest point\n// that maintains the cluster's diameter below a threshold.\n//\n// Parallelization strategy (CUDA):\n//   * The expensive part of the algorithm is that, in every round, *every*\n//     still-unclustered point is tried as a cluster seed and grown greedily.\n//     Those candidate clusters are completely independent of each other, so\n//     one CUDA warp is assigned to each seed and the warps are spread over\n//     the whole GPU (grid-stride over the seed list).\n//   * Inside a warp, the candidate points are processed cooperatively: every\n//     lane keeps a slice of the candidate list, the \"current maximum distance\n//     to any cluster member\" is maintained incrementally (mathematically\n//     identical to the O(size) rescan of the sequential code, since a maximum\n//     is exact and associative) and the closest admissible candidate is found\n//     with a warp shuffle reduction.\n//   * Because that running maximum is monotonically non-decreasing, a\n//     candidate whose value reaches the threshold can never become admissible\n//     again.  The candidate list is therefore compacted (warp-aggregated) in\n//     every step, which removes the vast majority of the sequential version's\n//     work without changing the result.\n//   * The pairwise distance matrix is precomputed once on the GPU when it fits\n//     into device memory; otherwise distances are evaluated on the fly with\n//     the exact same expression.\n//\n// The selection rules of the sequential code are reproduced bit-exactly:\n// the admissible candidate with the smallest diameter wins, ties are broken\n// towards the smaller point index, and among all seeds the one with the\n// largest cardinality wins, ties broken towards the earlier seed.\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                      \\\n    do {                                                                      \\\n        const cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                      \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                            \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d: %s\\n\", #call, __FILE__,  \\\n                    __LINE__, cudaGetErrorString(err_));                          // 8 warps / block\nstatic const int WARPS_PER_BLOCK = BLOCK_THREADS / WARP_SIZE;\nstatic const unsigned FULL_MASK = 0xffffffffu;\n\n// Generate synthetic 2D point data in clusters\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Device code\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ double devDistance(const Point a, const Point b) {\n    const double dx = a.x - b.x;\n    const double dy = a.y - b.y;\n    return sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// CSR-style adjacency listing, for every point, all other points that are\n// strictly closer than the threshold.  Only those can ever share a cluster\n// with it, so a candidate cluster never has to look at anything else.\n// `offsets == nullptr` means the lists were too large to precompute.\nstruct NeighborList {\n    const int* offsets;    // N + 1 entries\n    const int* idx;        // neighbour point ids\n    const double* dist;    // matching distances (all < threshold)\n};\n\n// Precompute the full (symmetric) pairwise distance matrix.\n__global__ void buildDistanceMatrix(const Point* __restrict__ points, int N,\n                                    double* __restrict__ dmat) {\n    const int j = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    const int i = blockIdx.y;\n    if (j >= N) return;\n    dmat[static_cast<size_t>(i) * N + j] = devDistance(points[i], points[j]);\n}\n\ntemplate <bool USE_MATRIX>\n__device__ __forceinline__ double lookupDistance(int a, int b,\n                                                 const Point* __restrict__ points,\n                                                 const double* __restrict__ dmat,\n                                                 int N) {\n    if (USE_MATRIX) {\n        return __ldg(&dmat[static_cast<size_t>(a) * N + b]);\n    }\n    return devDistance(points[a], points[b]);\n}\n\n// Pass 1 of the neighbour-list construction: how many points are in range.\ntemplate <bool USE_MATRIX>\n__global__ void countNeighbors(int N, double threshold,\n                               const Point* __restrict__ points,\n                               const double* __restrict__ dmat,\n                               int* __restrict__ counts) {\n    const int i = blockIdx.x;\n    int local = 0;\n    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < N; j += blockDim.x) {\n        if (j == i) continue;\n        if (lookupDistance<USE_MATRIX>(i, j, points, dmat, N) < threshold) ++local;\n    }\n    __shared__ int sTotal;\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) sTotal = 0;\n    __syncthreads();\n    atomicAdd(&sTotal, local);\n    __syncthreads();\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) counts[i] = sTotal;\n}\n\n// Pass 2: fill in the neighbour ids together with their distances.\ntemplate <bool USE_MATRIX>\n__global__ void fillNeighbors(int N, double threshold,\n                              const Point* __restrict__ points,\n                              const double* __restrict__ dmat,\n                              const int* __restrict__ offsets,\n                              int* __restrict__ nbrIdx, double* __restrict__ nbrDist) {\n    const int i = blockIdx.x;\n    const int lane = threadIdx.x & (WARP_SIZE - 1);\n    const unsigned lanesBelow = (1u << lane) - 1u;\n    const int base = offsets[i];\n\n    __shared__ int sCursor;\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) sCursor = 0;\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    const int lim = (N + blockDim.x - 1) / blockDim.x * blockDim.x;\n    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < lim; j += blockDim.x) {\n        double d = 0.0;\n        bool keep = false;\n        if (j < N && j != i) {\n            d = lookupDistance<USE_MATRIX>(i, j, points, dmat, N);\n            keep = d < threshold;\n        }\n        const unsigned mask = __ballot_sync(FULL_MASK, keep);\n        int warpBase = 0;\n        if (lane == 0) warpBase = atomicAdd(&sCursor, __popc(mask));\n        warpBase = __shfl_sync(FULL_MASK, warpBase, 0);\n        if (keep) {\n            const int pos = base + warpBase + __popc(mask & lanesBelow);\n            nbrIdx[pos] = j;\n            nbrDist[pos] = d;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Warp-wide reduction picking the smallest diameter; ties go to the smaller\n// point index (matching the sequential `max_dist < min_diameter` scan order).\n__device__ __forceinline__ void warpArgMin(double& bestDiam, int& bestIdx) {\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int off = WARP_SIZE / 2; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n        const double od = __shfl_down_sync(FULL_MASK, bestDiam, off);\n        const int oi = __shfl_down_sync(FULL_MASK, bestIdx, off);\n        if (od < bestDiam || (od == bestDiam && oi < bestIdx)) {\n            bestDiam = od;\n            bestIdx = oi;\n        }\n    }\n    bestDiam = __shfl_sync(FULL_MASK, bestDiam, 0);\n    bestIdx = __shfl_sync(FULL_MASK, bestIdx, 0);\n}\n\n// Grow the candidate cluster of one seed with a single warp.\n// Returns the cardinality; when `members` is non-null the member list is\n// written to it (in the order in which the sequential code appends them).\ntemplate <bool USE_MATRIX>\n__device__ int growCluster(int seed, int N, double threshold,\n                           const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                           const Point* __restrict__ points,\n                           const double* __restrict__ dmat,\n                           const NeighborList nbr,\n                           int* __restrict__ actA, double* __restrict__ diamA,\n                           int* __restrict__ actB, double* __restrict__ diamB,\n                           int* __restrict__ members) {\n    const int lane = threadIdx.x & (WARP_SIZE - 1);\n    const unsigned lanesBelow = (1u << lane) - 1u;\n\n    int* act = actA;\n    double* diam = diamA;\n    int* actNext = actB;\n    double* diamNext = diamB;\n\n    // Seed the candidate list: every unclustered point that is close enough to\n    // the seed itself.  Everything else can never join this cluster.\n    int count = 0;\n    if (nbr.offsets != nullptr) {\n        // Walk only the precomputed in-range neighbours of the seed.\n        const int begin = nbr.offsets[seed];\n        const int end = nbr.offsets[seed + 1];\n        const int lim = begin + (((end - begin) + WARP_SIZE - 1) & ~(WARP_SIZE - 1));\n        for (int k = begin + lane; k < lim; k += WARP_SIZE) {\n            int c = -1;\n            double d = 0.0;\n            bool keep = false;\n            if (k < end) {\n                c = nbr.idx[k];\n                d = nbr.dist[k];\n                keep = !clustered[c];\n            }\n            const unsigned mask = __ballot_sync(FULL_MASK, keep);\n            if (keep) {\n                const int pos = count + __popc(mask & lanesBelow);\n                act[pos] = c;\n                diam[pos] = d;\n            }\n            count += __popc(mask);\n        }\n    } else {\n        const int limN = (N + WARP_SIZE - 1) & ~(WARP_SIZE - 1);\n        for (int c = lane; c < limN; c += WARP_SIZE) {\n            double d = 0.0;\n            bool keep = (c < N) && (c != seed) && !clustered[c];\n            if (keep) {\n                d = lookupDistance<USE_MATRIX>(c, seed, points, dmat, N);\n                keep = d < threshold;\n            }\n            const unsigned mask = __ballot_sync(FULL_MASK, keep);\n            if (keep) {\n                const int pos = count + __popc(mask & lanesBelow);\n                act[pos] = c;\n                diam[pos] = d;\n            }\n            count += __popc(mask);\n        }\n    }\n\n    int cardinality = 1;\n    if (members != nullptr && lane == 0) members[0] = seed;\n\n    while (count > 0) {\n        // Closest admissible candidate.\n        double bestDiam = INFINITY;\n        int bestIdx = -1;\n        const int limC = (count + WARP_SIZE - 1) & ~(WARP_SIZE - 1);\n        for (int i = lane; i < limC; i += WARP_SIZE) {\n            if (i < count) {\n                const double d = diam[i];\n                const int idx = act[i];\n                if (d < bestDiam || (d == bestDiam && idx < bestIdx)) {\n                    bestDiam = d;\n                    bestIdx = idx;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        warpArgMin(bestDiam, bestIdx);\n\n        if (members != nullptr && lane == 0) members[cardinality] = bestIdx;\n        ++cardinality;\n\n        // Update the running diameters and drop candidates that became\n        // inadmissible (their diameter can only grow from here on).\n        int nextCount = 0;\n        for (int i = lane; i < limC; i += WARP_SIZE) {\n            double nd = 0.0;\n            int c = -1;\n            bool keep = false;\n            if (i < count) {\n                c = act[i];\n                keep = (c != bestIdx);\n                if (keep) {\n                    const double d = lookupDistance<USE_MATRIX>(c, bestIdx, points, dmat, N);\n                    nd = fmax(diam[i], d);\n                    keep = nd < threshold;\n                }\n            }\n            const unsigned mask = __ballot_sync(FULL_MASK, keep);\n            if (keep) {\n                const int pos = nextCount + __popc(mask & lanesBelow);\n                actNext[pos] = c;\n                diamNext[pos] = nd;\n            }\n            nextCount += __popc(mask);\n        }\n\n        int* ti = act;   act = actNext;       actNext = ti;\n        double* td = diam; diam = diamNext;   diamNext = td;\n        count = nextCount;\n    }\n\n    return cardinality;\n}\n\n// One warp per seed, grid-stride over the seed list.\ntemplate <bool USE_MATRIX>\n__global__ void candidateCardinalityKernel(int nSeeds, const int* __restrict__ seeds,\n                                           int N, double threshold,\n                                           const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                           const Point* __restrict__ points,\n                                           const double* __restrict__ dmat,\n                                           const NeighborList nbr,\n                                           int* __restrict__ actA, double* __restrict__ diamA,\n                                           int* __restrict__ actB, double* __restrict__ diamB,\n                                           int* __restrict__ memberScratch,\n                                           int* __restrict__ cardinality) {\n    const int lane = threadIdx.x & (WARP_SIZE - 1);\n    const int warpId = blockIdx.x * WARPS_PER_BLOCK + (threadIdx.x >> 5);\n    const int totalWarps = gridDim.x * WARPS_PER_BLOCK;\n    const size_t base = static_cast<size_t>(warpId) * N;\n\n    for (int s = warpId; s < nSeeds; s += totalWarps) {\n        // When one warp is available per seed (the common case) the member\n        // list is recorded right away, so the winner never has to be regrown.\n        int* members = (memberScratch != nullptr)\n                           ? memberScratch + static_cast<size_t>(s) * N\n                           : nullptr;\n        const int card = growCluster<USE_MATRIX>(seeds[s], N, threshold, clustered,\n                                                 points, dmat, nbr, actA + base,\n                                                 diamA + base, actB + base,\n                                                 diamB + base, members);\n        if (lane == 0) cardinality[s] = card;\n    }\n}\n\n// Largest cardinality wins; ties go to the earliest seed (the sequential code\n// only replaces the best on a strict `>`), single block.  When the member\n// lists were recorded, the winning one is also emitted here.\n__global__ void selectBestSeedKernel(int nSeeds, const int* __restrict__ cardinality,\n                                     const int* __restrict__ memberScratch, int N,\n                                     int* __restrict__ out,\n                                     int* __restrict__ bestPos) {\n    __shared__ int sCard[BLOCK_THREADS];\n    __shared__ int sPos[BLOCK_THREADS];\n\n    int bc = -1;\n    int bp = nSeeds;\n    for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < nSeeds; i += blockDim.x) {\n        const int c = cardinality[i];\n        if (c > bc) { bc = c; bp = i; }\n    }\n    sCard[threadIdx.x] = bc;\n    sPos[threadIdx.x] = bp;\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    for (int stride = blockDim.x >> 1; stride > 0; stride >>= 1) {\n        if (threadIdx.x < stride) {\n            const int oc = sCard[threadIdx.x + stride];\n            const int op = sPos[threadIdx.x + stride];\n            if (oc > sCard[threadIdx.x] ||\n                (oc == sCard[threadIdx.x] && op < sPos[threadIdx.x])) {\n                sCard[threadIdx.x] = oc;\n                sPos[threadIdx.x] = op;\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    const int pos = sPos[0];\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) bestPos[0] = pos;\n\n    if (memberScratch != nullptr) {\n        const int card = cardinality[pos];\n        if (threadIdx.x == 0) out[0] = card;\n        const int* src = memberScratch + static_cast<size_t>(pos) * N;\n        for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < card; i += blockDim.x) out[1 + i] = src[i];\n    }\n}\n\n// Regenerate the winning cluster and record its members.\n// out[0] = cardinality, out[1 .. cardinality] = members.\ntemplate <bool USE_MATRIX>\n__global__ void recordBestClusterKernel(const int* __restrict__ seeds,\n                                        const int* __restrict__ bestPos,\n                                        int N, double threshold,\n                                        const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n                                        const Point* __restrict__ points,\n                                        const double* __restrict__ dmat,\n                                        const NeighborList nbr,\n                                        int* __restrict__ actA, double* __restrict__ diamA,\n                                        int* __restrict__ actB, double* __restrict__ diamB,\n                                        int* __restrict__ out) {\n    const int lane = threadIdx.x & (WARP_SIZE - 1);\n    const int seed = seeds[bestPos[0]];\n    const int card = growCluster<USE_MATRIX>(seed, N, threshold, clustered, points, dmat,\n                                             nbr, actA, diamA, actB, diamB, out + 1);\n    if (lane == 0) out[0] = card;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Host driver\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nnamespace {\n\nstruct DeviceState {\n    Point* points = nullptr;\n    double* dmat = nullptr;          // optional precomputed distance matrix\n    unsigned char* clustered = nullptr;\n    int* seeds = nullptr;\n    int* cardinality = nullptr;\n    int* bestPos = nullptr;\n    int* out = nullptr;\n    int* actA = nullptr;\n    int* actB = nullptr;\n    double* diamA = nullptr;\n    double* diamB = nullptr;\n    int* memberScratch = nullptr;\n    int* nbrOffsets = nullptr;\n    int* nbrIdx = nullptr;\n    double* nbrDist = nullptr;\n    int warps = 0;\n    int blocks = 0;\n    bool useMatrix = false;\n};\n\n// Pick the number of concurrently resident warps: one per seed if the\n// per-warp scratch space fits, otherwise as many as memory allows.\nint chooseWarpCount(int N, size_t freeBytes, size_t matrixBytes) {\n    const size_t perWarp = static_cast<size_t>(N) * (3 * sizeof(int) + 2 * sizeof(double));\n    size_t budget = 0;\n    if (freeBytes > matrixBytes) {\n        budget = freeBytes - matrixBytes;\n        // Leave head room for the small bookkeeping arrays and the allocator.\n        budget = (budget > (256u << 20)) ? budget - (256u << 20) : budget / 2;\n    }\n    size_t maxWarps = budget / perWarp;\n    if (maxWarps < static_cast<size_t>(WARPS_PER_BLOCK)) maxWarps = WARPS_PER_BLOCK;\n    int warps = static_cast<int>(std::min<size_t>(maxWarps, static_cast<size_t>(N)));\n    // Round up to whole blocks.\n    warps = ((warps + WARPS_PER_BLOCK - 1) / WARPS_PER_BLOCK) * WARPS_PER_BLOCK;\n    return warps;\n}\n\n}  // namespace\n\n// Main QT clustering algorithm\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                                  const double threshold) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n    if (N == 0) return clusters;\n\n    std::vector<unsigned char> clustered(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered_indices(N);\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) unclustered_indices[i] = i;\n\n    size_t freeBytes = 0, totalBytes = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemGetInfo(&freeBytes, &totalBytes));\n\n    DeviceState dev;\n    const size_t matrixBytes = static_cast<size_t>(N) * static_cast<size_t>(N) * sizeof(double);\n    // Use the precomputed matrix whenever it comfortably fits; FP64 sqrt is\n    // expensive on the GPU, so this is a large win when it is affordable.\n    dev.useMatrix = (matrixBytes + matrixBytes / 4 + (256u << 20) < freeBytes);\n\n    dev.warps = chooseWarpCount(N, freeBytes, dev.useMatrix ? matrixBytes : 0);\n    dev.blocks = dev.warps / WARPS_PER_BLOCK;\n    const size_t scratch = static_cast<size_t>(dev.warps) * N;\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dev.points, N * sizeof(Point)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dev.clustered, N * sizeof(unsigned char)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dev.seeds, N * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dev.cardinality, N * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dev.bestPos, sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dev.out, (N + 1) * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dev.actA, scratch * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dev.actB, scratch * sizeof(int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dev.diamA, scratch * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dev.diamB, scratch * sizeof(double)));\n    if (dev.warps >= N) {\n        // Every seed gets its own warp, so its member list can be kept.\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dev.memberScratch, scratch * sizeof(int)));\n    }\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dev.points, points.data(), N * sizeof(Point),\n                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(dev.clustered, 0, N * sizeof(unsigned char)));\n\n    if (dev.useMatrix) {\n        if (cudaMalloc(&dev.dmat, matrixBytes) != cudaSuccess) {\n            dev.dmat = nullptr;\n            dev.useMatrix = false;\n        } else {\n            const int tpb = 256;\n            const dim3 grid((N + tpb - 1) / tpb, N);\n            buildDistanceMatrix<<<grid, tpb>>>(dev.points, N, dev.dmat);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Pinned staging buffers keep the per-round transfers cheap.\n    int* hSeeds = nullptr;\n    int* hOut = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&hSeeds, N * sizeof(int), cudaHostAllocDefault));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaHostAlloc(&hOut, (N + 1) * sizeof(int), cudaHostAllocDefault));\n\n    // Main clustering loop: one round per cluster.\n    while (!unclustered_indices.empty()) {\n        const int nSeeds = static_cast<int>(unclustered_indices.size());\n        std::copy(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(), hSeeds);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dev.seeds, hSeeds, nSeeds * sizeof(int),\n                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n        const int blocks = std::min(dev.blocks,\n                                    (nSeeds + WARPS_PER_BLOCK - 1) / WARPS_PER_BLOCK);\n        if (dev.useMatrix) {\n            candidateCardinalityKernel<true><<<blocks, BLOCK_THREADS>>>(\n                nSeeds, dev.seeds, N, threshold, dev.clustered, dev.points, dev.dmat,\n                nbr, dev.actA, dev.diamA, dev.actB, dev.diamB, dev.memberScratch,\n                dev.cardinality);\n        } else {\n            candidateCardinalityKernel<false><<<blocks, BLOCK_THREADS>>>(\n                nSeeds, dev.seeds, N, threshold, dev.clustered, dev.points, dev.dmat,\n                nbr, dev.actA, dev.diamA, dev.actB, dev.diamB, dev.memberScratch,\n                dev.cardinality);\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n        selectBestSeedKernel<<<1, BLOCK_THREADS>>>(nSeeds, dev.cardinality,\n                                                   dev.memberScratch, N, dev.out,\n                                                   dev.bestPos);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n        if (dev.memberScratch == nullptr) {\n            // Not enough memory to keep every member list: regrow the winner.\n            if (dev.useMatrix) {\n                recordBestClusterKernel<true><<<1, WARP_SIZE>>>(\n                    dev.seeds, dev.bestPos, N, threshold, dev.clustered, dev.points,\n                    dev.dmat, nbr, dev.actA, dev.diamA, dev.actB, dev.diamB, dev.out);\n            } else {\n                recordBestClusterKernel<false><<<1, WARP_SIZE>>>(\n                    dev.seeds, dev.bestPos, N, threshold, dev.clustered, dev.points,\n                    dev.dmat, nbr, dev.actA, dev.diamA, dev.actB, dev.diamB, dev.out);\n            }\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        }\n\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hOut, dev.out, (N + 1) * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n\n        const int cardinality = hOut[0];\n        Cluster cluster;\n        cluster.seed_point = hOut[1];\n        cluster.members.assign(hOut + 1, hOut + 1 + cardinality);\n        clusters.push_back(cluster);\n\n        for (int i = 0; i < cardinality; ++i) clustered[cluster.members[i]] = 1;\n        unclustered_indices.erase(\n            std::remove_if(unclustered_indices.begin(), unclustered_indices.end(),\n                           [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx] != 0; }),\n            unclustered_indices.end());\n\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dev.clustered, clustered.data(),\n                                   N * sizeof(unsigned char), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    }\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hSeeds));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFreeHost(hOut));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dev.points));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dev.clustered));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dev.seeds));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dev.cardinality));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dev.bestPos));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dev.out));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dev.actA));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dev.actB));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dev.diamA));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dev.diamB));\n    if (dev.memberScratch) CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dev.memberScratch));\n    if (dev.dmat) CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dev.dmat));\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// Validation: check that clusters satisfy the QT clustering properties\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters,\n                     const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                     const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n\n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n\n    // Check each cluster\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n\n        // Check diameter (max distance between any two points)\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist = distance(points[cluster.members[i]],\n                                           points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (c < 10) { // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %zu: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\",\n                   c, cluster.members.size(), cluster.seed_point, max_diameter);\n        }\n\n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (max_diameter > threshold * 1.001) { // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %zu has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\",\n                   c, max_diameter, threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (size_t c = 0; c < clusters.size(); ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %zu)\\n\",\n                       member, membership[member], c);\n                valid = false;\n            }\n            membership[member] = static_cast<int>(c);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Count clustered points\n    int clustered_count = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < membership.size(); ++i) {\n        if (membership[i] >= 0) clustered_count++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Total points: %zu, Clustered: %d, Unclustered: %zu\\n\",\n           points.size(), clustered_count, points.size() - clustered_count);\n\n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s The candidate list is therefore compacted (warp-aggregated) in\n//     every step, which removes the vast majority of the sequential version's\n//     work without changing the result.\n//   * The pairwise distance matrix is precomputed once on the GPU when it fits\n//     into device memory; Within a warp, lanes hold slices of the candidate list, the running \"max distance to any cluster member\" is maintained incrementally, and the closest admissible candidate is picked with a shuffle reduction.\n\nFour optimizations on top, all semantics-preserving:\n\n1. **Monotone pruning + warp-aggregated compaction** — the running max never decreases, so a candidate that hits the threshold is dropped permanently instead of being rescanned every step (the sequential version rescans all N points per added member).\n2. **Precomputed CSR neighbour lists** — a seed can only ever draw from points within `threshold` of it, so the initial scan is proportional to the neighbourhood instead of N.\n3. **Cross-round memoization** — a candidate cluster only changes if one of the seed's neighbours was just clustered, so each round re-grows only the seeds the previous round touched (~10x fewer per round). Cardinalities and member lists are cached per seed.\n4. **Device-resident rounds** — winner selection, commit, and rebuilding the seed/work lists are kernels, so rounds are enqueued in batches of 32 with no per-round host sync.
